span.p:
Building Footprints
Features: building_count_*, Tallest_Building_*HEIGHT, Average_Building_Height*
Sources: Contest Dataset, NYC Open Data

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
OSM Features
Features: dist_to_road/park/water, roads_ratio_*, parks_ratio_*, water_ratio_*, transit_count_*, etc.
Source: OpenStreetMap - OSMnx

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Street Trees
Features: tree_count_*, tree_avg_diam_*
Source: NYC Open Data - 2015 Street Tree Census

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Air Quality
Features: PM 2.5, NO2, Ozone, SO2, CO - avg, median, etc.
Sources: NYC Open Data, AirNow.gov - EPA, NOAA, NASA

display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

Mesonet Weather
Features: air_temp_surface, relative_humidity, wind_speed, etc.
Source: Contest Dataset - NY Mesonet

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Satellite Imagery
Features: NDVI, NDWI, Moisture_index, False_color, Brightness_Temperature, etc.
Sources: Sentinel-2/3, Landsat 8 - Contest Dataset

span.p:
Cooling Towers
Features: tower_count_*
Source: NYC Open Data

Energy & Water
Features: sum_net_emissions_mtco2e_*, site_energy_use_*, etc.
Source: NYC Open Data

span.p:
Census Tracts
Features: population_density, median_income, poverty_count, etc.
Source: NYC Open Data - 2020 Census

span.p:
Hyperlocal Temp
Features: AvgTemp_*, MaxTemp_*, UHI_* - June-Aug 2018
Source: NYC Open Data

span.p:
Wind Atlas
Features: air_density, power_density
Source: Global Wind Atlas

span.p:
Street Pavement
Features: Width, Rating_B
Source: NYC Open Data

span.p:
Traffic Volume
Features: Traffic_Volume_Avg, Traffic_Volume_med, etc.
Source: NYC Open Data

span.p:
NOAA nClimGrid
Features: nclimgrid_band1, ..., nclimgrid_band4
Source: NOAA

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Exploratory Data Analysis
- Feature Distribution: Histograms, Boxplots
- Correlation Analysis: Removed highly correlated features
e.g., Average_Building_Height_500m & 750m, corr=0.92

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Initial Processing
- Dropped Latitude, Longitude, datetime
- Non-model columns removed

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Data Cleaning & Imputation
- Dropped columns with >50% missing values
- 32 features removed
- KNN Imputation - n_neighbors=5

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Feature Engineering
- Created interaction features
- Temp, building, water, tree, park-related
- +5 features added

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Explored Methods
- IV, RFE, GA, SA, Boruta, VI, LR

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Best Method: ExtraTreesRegressor
- Median threshold
- Reduced features from 244 to 122 - 50%

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Initial Model Exploration
- Tested: NN, Linear Regression, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, CatBoost
- Low performance - R² < 0.95

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Hyperparameter Optimization
- ExtraTrees & XGBoost: Optuna - 200 trials, TPE sampler
- LightGBM: BayesSearchCV - 30 iterations
- 5-fold Cross-Validation

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Model Blending
- Weighted blending of ExtraTrees, XGBoost, LightGBM
- Weights based on validation R² scores
- No improvement - R²: 0.973082

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Best Model: ExtraTreesRegressor
- Validation R²: 0.973478
- Outperformed blending - R²: 0.973082

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Retraining
- Retrained ExtraTrees on full training data
- Best Parameters: n_estimators=500, max_depth=36, min_samples_split=2, min_samples_leaf=1, max_features=0.3283, bootstrap=False

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Key Findings
- Top 10 Features: nclimgrid_band1 - 0.0397, Income_1000m - 0.0325, Income_500m - 0.0259, Average_Building_Height_1000m - 0.0231, tree_avg_diam_1000m - 0.0204, roads_ratio_1000m - 0.0204, nclimgrid_band4 - 0.0193, Traffic_Volume_med - 0.0171, Average_Building_Height_750m - 0.0167, parks_ratio_1000m - 0.0166

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Prediction
- Generated predictions on validation dataset
- Created submission file with Latitude, Longitude, and predicted UHI Index
